Sample Sphinx Documentation

Modules

A simple calculator module.

This module provides basic arithmetic operations.

sample_project.calculator.add(a, b)

Add two numbers.

Parameters:

  • a – First number

  • b – Second number

Returns:

Sum of a and b

sample_project.calculator.divide(a, b)

Divide one number by another.

Parameters:

  • a – First number (numerator)

  • b – Second number (denominator)

Returns:

Quotient of a and b

Raises:

ZeroDivisionError – If b is zero

sample_project.calculator.multiply(a, b)

Multiply two numbers.

Parameters:

  • a – First number

  • b – Second number

Returns:

Product of a and b

sample_project.calculator.subtract(a, b)

Subtract one number from another.

Parameters:

  • a – First number

  • b – Second number

Returns:

Difference of a and b

Data processing utilities.

This module provides functions to process and analyze data.

sample_project.data_processor.calculate_average(numbers)

Calculate the average of a list of numbers.

Parameters:

numbers – List of numbers

Returns:

Average of the numbers

Raises:

ValueError – If the list is empty

sample_project.data_processor.filter_even_numbers(numbers)

Filter even numbers from a list.

Parameters:

numbers – List of integers

Returns:

List of even integers

sample_project.data_processor.find_max(numbers)

Find the maximum value in a list of numbers.

Parameters:

numbers – List of numbers

Returns:

Maximum value

Utility functions.

This module provides general utility functions.

sample_project.utils.read_file(file_path)

Read the contents of a file.

Parameters:

file_path – Path to the file

Returns:

Contents of the file as a string

sample_project.utils.reverse_string(s)

Reverse a given string.

Parameters:

s – Input string

Returns:

Reversed string

sample_project.utils.write_file(file_path, content)

Write content to a file.

Parameters:

  • file_path – Path to the file

  • content – Content to write
